notes: The two ἐν tokens are Semitic complementizers the ASV absorbs into a plain transitive confess, so rule 36's absorbed-into-a-predicate clause leaves them unrepresented; the marginal notes Greek in me and Greek in him are the evidence. A reference comparison will report them as disagreements.
τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς is rule 31's prepositional-phrase carve-out: the article keeps who and the copula goes with ἐν, as are in does at τὰ στρατεύματα τὰ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
